name: Quadricuspid Aortic Valve

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Echocardiographic and Surgical Classification Criteria for Quadricuspid Aortic Valve

criteria.description: Visualization of four distinct aortic valve cusps on transthoracic or transesophageal echocardiography
Intraoperative or autopsy confirmation of four aortic valve cusps
Presence of aortic valve regurgitation demonstrated by Doppler echocardiography

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Definitive diagnosis requires echocardiographic visualization of four distinct aortic valve cusps; surgical confirmation is supportive.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Differentiation from tricuspid or bicuspid valves with fenestrations is essential.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Aortic valve regurgitation due to cusp malcoaptation
searchTerms: aortic valve leaking due to cusp mismatch
blood flowing backward through aortic valve

common.symptomName: Exertional dyspnea due to aortic insufficiency

searchTerms: palpitations due to heart volume increase
heart racing from excess blood volume
heart murmur from leaking aortic valve
abnormal heart sound due to valve regurgitation
enlarged left heart chamber on scan

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to decreased cardiac output
searchTerms: fatigue due to low cardiac output

occasional.symptomName: Heart failure symptoms in advanced cases

rare.symptomName: Conduction abnormalities such as heart block
searchTerms: heart rhythm problems like heart block

imaging: Echocardiography showing four aortic valve cusps
Cardiac MRI or CT confirming valve morphology and ventricular size
other: Histopathological examination of excised valve tissue

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of two aortic valve cusps instead of four
Different pattern of valve dysfunction and associated aortopathy
Three cusps with fenestrations mimicking additional cusps
Valve morphology confirmed by detailed imaging or surgery

redFlags: Severe aortic regurgitation causing heart failure
Rapid progression of left ventricular dilation
Signs of infective endocarditis on valve
references: Gurley JC, et al. Quadricuspid Aortic Valve: A Comprehensive Review. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2020.
Roberts WC. The quadricuspid aortic valve: a study of 12 necropsy cases. Am J Cardiol. 1973.
